description: A commitment spoken through the virtual microphone is extracted by real Groq, acknowledged into the isolated SQLite database by the mutation queue, and recalled aloud on a later turn.

events.text: Roma, remember that I need to send Matt the building five HVAC quote tomorrow morning.

events.message: the spoken commitment must become a durable memory record
the mutation queue must reach the isolated SQLite server

events.text: Roma, what did I ask you to remember about Matt?
